title: Authentication and authorization
problem: New or changed routes can bypass identity, role or resource authorization.
rationale: Product gate for new/changed routes. Public routes need a recorded reviewed reason. Existing human-only gates cannot be loosened by a reviewer or profile.
applicability: New or changed public/protected routes, identity and resource access policies.
baseline_policy: No legacy waiver for required verification or release prerequisites.

target_check.deterministic: route inventory diff, explicit public/protected classification, tests for unauthenticated, forbidden-role and cross-resource/tenant access as applicable; configured framework route checks.
target_check.reviewer: correct policy for every new route. Unknown route-framework discovery requires reviewer declaration; no claim of universal detection.
target_check.limits: **D:** route inventory diff, explicit public/protected classification, tests for unauthenticated, forbidden-role and cross-resource/tenant access as applicable; configured framework route checks. **R:** correct policy for every new route. Unknown route-framework discovery requires reviewer declaration; no claim of universal detection.
target_check.configuration: Project-approved native configuration, immutable source/tool/config pins and applicable evidence mappings; Product gate for new/changed routes. Public routes need a recorded reviewed reason. Existing human-only gates cannot be loosened by a reviewer or profile.

repair: Classify the route, enforce the intended identity/role/resource policy, and add unauthenticated, forbidden and cross-resource negative tests. Missing prerequisites remain Unsupported/Error.
